notes: MUTABLE Android draft; 1000-subject proposed cap pending named owner, 15-minute bounded shared lease. Linked fixtures are models, NOT live-store tests or formal Android ACK.

cases.name: independent_101_change_fixture_first_100
cases.fixture: Separate gen8 history: subjects 555 and 666 followed rev1/2, then 100 single-subject changes at rev3..102 (one unfollow 555 plus 99 new follows), followed by unfollow 666 at rev103. Snapshot checkpoint gen8/rev2; page limit fixed 100.

cases.name: capacity_snapshot_page_1_not_authoritative
cases.fixture: Gen12 exactly 1000 distinct followed UUIDs rev1000; 10 pages of 100. One shared snapshot/export pinned image <=1MiB logical owner/project/cohort budget; no cursorless request can allocate another. Concurrent writes after rev1000 excluded.

cases.name: capacity_export_page_1_is_not_full_export
cases.fixture: Exactly 1000 distinct followed UUIDs at gen12/rev1000; pages 1..10 enumerate ascending UUID keys, 100/page; page excerpts do not imply missing intermediate pages. Concurrent writes after rev1000 must not alter pinned result.

cases.name: capacity_changes_first_page_pins_fixed_upper
cases.fixture: Gen12 1000 eligible changes rev1..1000; after_revision0. Rev1001..2000 append concurrently AFTER fixed upper1000. Exactly 10 pages of 100. Old checkpoint0 until complete.

cases.name: capacity_first_page_429_reserves_lease_before_reply
cases.fixture: Admitted generation12/revision1000 owner snapshot; durable fixed 15-minute lease reserved before first 429

cases.name: owner_initial_429_lost_retries_cursorless_without_new_pinned_image
cases.fixture: Phone A lost the first 429 body; repeats same first URL after app restart while phone B also reads. Atomic owner-wide reuse returns same pinned gen12/rev1000/lease, no new rows; page0 cannot get a second 429.

cases.name: phone_b_concurrent_export_reuses_phone_a_image
cases.fixture: Phone B uses same underlying owner-wide pinned image as Phone A snapshot; export cursor remains purpose-bound.

cases.name: non_equivalent_phone_b_changes_use_shared_snapshot_fallback
cases.fixture: Phone A holds only available fixed-upper change slot after_revision=0; phone B different R does not evict A. Phone B can read owner-wide shared snapshot.

cases.name: fresh_lease_budget_exhausted_before_first_429
cases.fixture: Distinct owner image must reserve 1MiB logical budget; no existing equivalent image, physical project budget refuses reservation. Fail closed BEFORE page/429.

cases.name: owner_budget_released_at_15min_next_first_request_recovers
cases.fixture: Prior lease expired exactly 15min, cleanup freed reservation, new first request admitted fresh lease at new pinned revision.

cases.name: stale_shared_image_rev1_rejected_for_phone_b_min_rev2
cases.fixture: Phone A has active image pinned rev1 while phone B unfollows rev2; fresh B requests min_revision=2; no stale image reused and no in-flight eviction. Fixed expiry <=15min.

cases.name: stale_lease_expired_new_image_proves_rev2_unfollow
cases.fixture: After <=15min old rev1 image GC frees slot and new image pins rev2; known phone B unfollow now reflected.
